summary: Learn to structure infrastructure registers, assess condition, and prioritize renewal budgets. Explore the five-day course and practical curriculum.
lede: Public infrastructure asset management training helps teams link asset records and condition evidence to maintenance and renewal decisions. Designed for public works officials, asset managers, investment teams, and engineering consultants, it covers register design, condition ratings, data checks, risk assessment, GIS mapping, lifecycle-cost comparison, and capital-prioritization scorecards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for public infrastructure inventories, condition evidence, and capital decisions across roads, buildings, and municipal infrastructure.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with public works, infrastructure planning, asset data, engineering, or public investment processes is recommended. No coding or fixed-asset accounting experience is required. Bring a laptop for exercises; QGIS is optional and available as free, open-source software.
